rounds.builds: His look at round 9 (2026-10-14 23:24, redirect): the otter's legs point in strange ways, and lying on a rock will fight movement, rigging and animation. Position, stands unless he flips it (the record already makes the living creature the animal and only the highest ally form humanoid): every Romp living creature is a quadruped standing on its own four feet on the ground, in a neutral stance a quadruped rig can animate, with no prop under it or in its paws. Rebuild the otter's and the kid goat's creature stages that way (the goat's mid-leap off a rock has the same problem) with clean, symmetric leg chains (shoulder, elbow, wrist, paw; hip, knee, hock, paw) that match the skeleton-first spirit rigs (bars-engine #325, read-only here); the otter keeps its long low body and tail, its token moves to the beads, the goat's bell stays at its throat. Check the fox's lifted forepaw against the same rule. Upright forms are unchanged. Put the position on the board as a row.
rounds.check: Side and three-quarter renders of the otter, kid goat and fox creatures in all five elements, four feet flat on the ground, legs bending the way the animal's do; sprite sheet beside round 10's.

rounds.builds: Spirit states (pass spirit-states 1, 2026-10-16, positions ss-markers, ss-feral-stance, ss-not-veiled): the Shellback tortoise in one element (wood, his reference) in all five forms by three states, dissatisfied, neutral and satisfied, built on the same model as a rig pose plus material settings (no second model). Dissatisfied: the Protector's push held and braced (forelegs wide, head low under the rim, shell tipped forward), ragged inward-pulling aura in a darker, denser shade, narrowed eyes with a hot glint, cracked stuttering core, rougher shell and skin. Satisfied: the push completed and open, slow smooth wider aura with a bright rim (brightness, not gold), soft eyes, whole steady core. Neutral: today's render. Gas shows aura only, core the core, hologram aura and scanline. Living creature stays on four feet. Plus the veil test pair: the dissatisfied creature beside one veiled at polarity 6 and one flooding at -6. Comes before the next family's first base so every later family is built with its states from the start.
rounds.check: State squint test: fifteen 96 px sprites shuffled with labels off; pass if 13 of 15 are sorted by state. Veil test: no pair of dissatisfied, veiled and flooding confused.
